sloka: तस्य एवम् ब्रुवतः अमात्याः तथा इति उक्त्वा समाहिताः ।न्यवेशयम्स् तामः चन्देन स्वेन स्वेन पृथक् पृथक् ॥२-८३-२५॥
transliteration: tasya evam bruvataḥ amātyāḥ tathā iti uktvā samāhitāḥ ।nyaveśayams tāmaḥ candena svena svena pṛthak pṛthak ॥2-83-25॥

translations.english: While he (Bharata's) was speaking this way, all the ministers assented by saying 'Be it so' and made arrangement for their troops to rest separately according to their pleasure.
